text:
amanda: Heads up — saw quicknav showing other org hints when switching fast. repro steps below.

jason: ugh, can you paste steps?

amanda: 1) click org switcher, 2) rapid search, 3) open dashboard preview; saw cards from previous org

sara: do we have logs? any header missing?

amanda: grabbed console logs: `x-org-id` present, but `x-routing-hint` flips — might be race between prefetch and route update

kyle: sounds like prefetch pipeline doesn't bind tenant context to async result. Could be `prefetcher` using global workspace variable.

mike: rolling out quota-affinity last week added a new cache key. maybe collision? cache key uses userID+route, not org

jason: if cache key lacks org it's a leak. but why only quicknav? async prefetch + shared global cache

sara: can someone grep for where `CacheKey` constructed in console prefetch flow? I can triage telemetry traces

amanda: attaching sample log: ```INFO prefetch result id=abc123 route=/dashboard preview org=org-A user=u1 cache_key="user:u1:route:/dashboard"``` shows missing org in cache_key

kyle: minimal fix: include org in cache key and patch telemetry to log org for prefetched payloads. Also add unit test for rapid org swap.

mike: also add canary rollback plan — if we change cache key, we invalidate caches; coordinate with infra

jason: agreed. I'll PR today and add migration note. assign @sara for telemetry additions. @ops-bot pls schedule canary for tomorrow 10am.

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy to 6% of traffic @ 10:00 UTC tomorrow

amanda: thanks team, will monitor any alerts.
